blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — A power outage added to the discomfort of residents in Tinglayan, Kalinga, on Monday, as rains brought by the shear line continued to affect the town. The Tinglayan Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office said the bad weather had not disrupted road access but warned motorists to exercise caution because of possible landslides, road blockages, and slippery conditions. Communication services remained stable as of Monday, the office said.
